analysis.reasonEn: RSI remains at 44.3 in the neutral zone, and ADX is at 23.4, indicating an early stage of trend formation. While the MACD histogram shows improvement, a trend reversal is not yet confirmed. The volume ratio of 0.46 compared to the 5-day average suggests subdued activity, adding to the uncertainty. Therefore, a wait-and-see approach is warranted pending further indicator confirmation.
